events.title: Attack UKMTO #211 18 November 2026 UKMTO WARNING 211-26 - UKMTO has received a time-late report of an incident 13NM north of Khasab, Oman. Local authorities report a tanker was struck by an unknown projectile within the Strait of Hormuz. A fire occurred onboard, which has since been extinguished. Search and rescue efforts are underway for a missing crew member, currently unaccounted for. Vessel damage assessment and environmental impact are unknown at the time of this report. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO. Attack UKMTO #208 16 November 2026 UKMTO WARNING 208-226. UKMTO has received a report of an incident 7NM north of Khasab, Oman. A third-party has reported an attack involving a tanker transiting the Strait of Hormuz, disabling the vessel and resulting in an engine room fire. The crew have been reported safe. Damage assessment, and environmental impact are unknown at the time of this report. UPDATE 001-170745Z: UKMTO has received reports from a maritime security agency that the vessel sustained a second strike, which caused a fired onboard. The crew are currently unaccounted for, and damage assessment is unknown at present. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO, whilst authorities investigate.

Attack UKMTO #207 16 November 2026 UKMTO has received a report of an incident in the Strait of Hormuz. The Company Security Officer of a Tanker has reported the vessel being struck by an unknown projectile whilst transiting outbound. This resulted in a fire in the engine room. No casualties have been reported and all crew have been accounted for. Damage assessment and environmental impact unknown at present. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO, whilst authorities investigate.

Suspicious Activity UKMTO #206 16 November 2026 UKMTO WARNING 206-26 - SUSPICIOUS ACTIVITY Incident Date: 16 Nov 26 Incident Time: 0330UTC UKMTO has received a report of an incident 430NM east of Socotra, Yemen. The Master of a tanker has reported being approached by a possible mothership and skiff in position 1202N 06147E. Four armed persons were sighted onboard the skiff, with a ladder also visible. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO, whilst authorities investigate.

Attack UKMTO #205 15 November 2026 UKMTO is aware of a report by Indian Shipping Authorities of an attack on a Tanker while transiting through the Arabian Gulf eastbound prior to entering the Strait of Hormuz. The crew are accounted for and safe. Damage assessment and environmental impact are unknown at time of report. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO.

Attack UKMTO #209 13 November 2026 UKMTO has received a time-late verified report of an incident in the Arabian Gulf. A Tanker was struck by unknown projectile while transiting through the Arabian Gulf, eastbound prior to entering the Strait of Hormuz. All crew are safe and accounted for. Damage assessment and environmental impact are unknown at time of report. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO, whilst authorities investigate.

Attack UKMTO #204 11 November 2026 UKMTO WARNING 204-26 - ATTACK Incident Date: 11 Nov 2026 Incident Time: 1800UTC UKMTO has received a time-late report of an incident 14NM northwest of Ra’s al Khaymah, UAE. A tanker was struck by an unknown projectile in the engine room. No casualties have been reported and all crew have been evacuated safely. Fire-fighting efforts are currently ongoing. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO, whilst authorities investigate.

Suspicious Activity UKMTO #202 11 November 2026 UKMTO WARNING 202-26. UPDATE 001 UKMTO has received a report of an incident involving a tanker in the Strait of Hormuz. The status of crew, damage assessment, and environmental impact are unknown at the time of this report. UPDATE 001: UKMTO have now gained confirmation that the tanker was struck with an unknown projectile whilst transiting the Strait of Hormuz. All crew are reported safe and well. Due to this confirmation, this has been re-classified as an Attack. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO, whilst authorities investigate.
